<subject>SIAM invitation</subject>
<body>
Hospicare Alliance

here is an email invitation for the SIAM event. A hard copy will follow

Dr. V. Kaminski  
Lumière Santé  
BP 1188  
Saint-Priest, Lyon 69800

Hospicare Alliance

10 mars 2025

I am writing to formalize your invitation to attend, participate, and speak at the SIAM Southwest Regional Healthcare Innovation Workshop. A time slot of thirty minutes is being allotted to invited presentations with an additional ten minutes or so for discussion. The workshop, funded under the auspices of Hospicare Alliance grant to SIAM, will not be a standard healthcare conference with representatives from hospitals, research centers, and public health agencies presenting their latest findings. Instead, the meeting will emphasize the medical technologies and clinical methodologies currently applied to the projects of healthcare providers and public health institutions. Additionally, the event will focus upon the mechanisms facilitating interaction and collaboration between clinical teams, research institutions, and healthcare administration.

The workshop will be held at Medinovus Center, April 25-28. Santé Lyon Metropole will be available to support both travel expenses and the cost of accommodation and meals for invited speakers. We will be happy to assist with travel arrangements on our side if desired.

We hope that you can accept our invitation. If so, please provide us with a presentation title, a short abstract, and a list of any technical equipment required for your talk.

We look forward to seeing you at Clinique Lumière Santé.

Sincerely

Christophe Rivière  
Specialist  
Lumière Santé SAS  
+33 4 78 00 12 34  
12 rue des Docteurs Charcot  
69008 Lyon  
France
